My partner has a kidney infection to the point where she is in excruciating pain, dizzy and suffering confusion. Trying to call the desk and actually speak to a human is pointless because you are made to fill out an online e-form to determine whether or not you are even worthy of a conversation. Decided to actually go to the building and was told to urinate in a sample pot and take it to the pharmacy over the way. When we got there we were told this was not possible as they don’t provide that service. Went back to the surgery where we unfortunately interrupted their secretarial conversation (the place was empty)  to be told ‘come back Monday’ - absolutely shocking.

These places are meant to help. Not make you feel like an inconvenience. Attitude towards the whole situation was ‘not our problem’. Currently sat in Dartmoor walk-in Center more than 24 hours later where her condition has deteriorated further whilst STILL waiting to receive antibiotics for what is a relatively straightforward diagnosis and easy solution.
Maybe they could have recommended this in the first instance if they had half a clue or even bothered to engage and provide a productive service. Just to top it off we’ve received a parking fine for being over the ‘allocated half-hr’ time frame at the hospital. There were literally about 5 cars in a 50-odd birth vicinity.
Amazing. 😂
What an absolute joke the system is. Made worse by people that are unprofessional and just do not take their jobs seriously. There is no empathy. There is no urgency. And there certainly is no efficiency. Just shocking.",null,[0,203]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s5UFVsZHhSWFUwVWpWMWVISmpkazA1U0RKT2VIYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xb27a898604883d20!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOk9PUldxRXU0UjV1eHJjdk05SDJOeHc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s5UFVsZHhSWFUwVWpWMWVISmpkazA1U0RKT2VIYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjgrILsz7STAxW4AGMBHaPFMycQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjgrILsz7STAxW4AGMBHaPFMycQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMUZQTVdrd1ZWOWZSV2hEUW0xSFJrZEpNMU4yU0RremVXOWxjMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSV1VOYVFUZFhURkpSV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pkZlYzWTRPWEJSYWpCMWNqbEtSbFJUTVhadmFWRRAB",["0x0:0xb27a898604883d20",null,1752061807336126,1764934318993492,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/117185411823962857596/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["MaDMaXz","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVf-zcMWfZCx4-0D8mpwGmjdL0SZ9-iqZNyMP1m2lrrfyjx1Dg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/117185411823962857596?hl=en"],"117185411823962857596",null,6,0,null,[0,3,1],0,["6 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjgrILsz7STAxW4AGMBHaPFMycQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"Edited 3 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Got to be the worst docs in Plymouth incompetent reception staff managed by the most condescending c word iv ever met  completely run on pure incompetence AVOID AVOID AVOID! to sum up how bad this surgery is I went to make a complaint was point blank refused and then held under a lie to a see a doctor while they phoned the police... the police obviously did nothing complete waste of their time the WPC said.. but the service i now receive from kicking off in this place is incredible!!
